about: A holdout for the addressedToAi reader of the requirements excerpt (supabase/functions/agent-mcp/posting-excerpt.ts): 40 lines written to an AI (addressed) and 40 that only mention one (mentionOnly), written on 2026-11-17 before the reader was changed for its second review, and never used to change a pattern. Each line was read after a short requirements list. With the reader at c9f535e10 it flagged 19 of the 40, 20 came back in postingExcerpt as if they were requirements, and 1 was left out unquoted; it flagged none of the mention-only lines and kept 39 of them in postingExcerpt. After the change it flags 22, 16 come back in postingExcerpt, 2 are left out unquoted, and it still flags none of the mention-only lines and keeps 39. A line no pattern was written for is still missed about half the time, so a posting whose excerpt carries no addressedToAi has not been shown to hold no such line.
